description: Ask GolfCore's AI caddie a question about the shot in front of the golfer, such as which club to hit or where to aim. Pass their lat and lng and the question in their words. The caddie answers with the golfer's own handicap and club distances from their GolfCore account, so the golfer signs in to GolfCore the first time. It needs a GolfCore plan that includes AI caddie reads.

accuracy_m.description: Optional. The location's horizontal accuracy in meters, when the device reports it.

course.description: Optional. The course slug, when known. Otherwise the course is found from the position.

hole.description: Optional. The hole number the golfer says they are on. Otherwise the hole is chosen from the position.

lat.description: The golfer's latitude, from their phone or glasses.

question.description: The golfer's question, in their words.

name: ask_caddie
title: Ask the GolfCore caddie
